title: Fixed Orthogonal Fences and Diagonal Jaw Corner Vise
description: One newly authored complete fixed right-angle corner-vise-style exterior. One continuous L-shaped ground foundation carries two full perpendicular fixed high fences. A whole diagonal low rib connects the inside corner region to a separate thick axial guide boss with a real through bore. One independent full triangular moving-jaw appearance presents two perpendicular flat faces toward the two fixed fences, leaving two distinct open channels. A complete diagonally aligned spindle passes through the bored boss into the rear of that head, with a full transverse handbar and two end stops. The complete right-angle opposing-face organization is not the old clamp-on bench vise with one jaw merely rotated: there is no table-edge C clamp, parallel flat-jaw pair or rectangular longitudinal slide. Unlike the long F clamp there is no long bar with one sliding collar carrying a single opposed pad. All geometry newly authored together, only generic solid mesh helpers reused. Three opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up and full horizontal-envelope centred ground datum. One complete model zero scenes. Empty fixed artistic tool appearance only: no timber, workpiece fit, moving adjustment, thread engagement, clamping force, right-angle precision, torque, installation, load, manufacture or safety capability. Broad spindle rings are fixed exterior profile, not a functioning helical thread. Rigging animation and interaction not made.
